Governance and office of the CEO · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Post-investment review

Simon · Capital Projects Analyst

Of the 23 investments above R$ 2 million that the CEO of a pharmacy chain approved in 4 years, only 4 were reviewed after completion.

When it runs
Every tenth business day of the month at 7 a.m., after the accounting close, on the investments completing 6, 12 or 24 months of operation that month
What it delivers in production
The CEO and the CFO receive a monthly bulletin with the investments that reached the 6, 12 or 24-month milestone, with the promise and the measured indicator, and the verdict on each one.
Who decides
Measures and classifies; the CEO follows up
Effort
Calibrate on 4 reviews; 3 supervised months
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output

Done when

# Post-investment review scale

## Milestone
- Reference month: the month before the base date (the bulletin comes out on the tenth business day).
- Operation date: effective_date from schedule.csv; with no row in the schedule, operation_start_date.
- At the milestone: operation date plus 6, 12 or 24 months falls inside the reference month. Whoever is not at the milestone does not appear in the bulletin.
- No effective_date and no operation_start_date: NO MILESTONE DEFINED.

## Measurement
- Use only the rows of actuals.csv with the same scope as the paper (scope column of investments.csv).
- BASE: 12 months before operation. If it differs from the paper's baseline by more than 0.5 point, record the divergence; the calculation uses the paper's baseline.
- MEASURED: months of operation up to the reference month, at most 12. Fewer months: INCOMPLETE PERIOD, no verdict.
- Delivery = (measured minus baseline) / (target minus baseline). It applies to indicators that go up and to those that go down.
- Scale: above 80% MET; from 50% to 80%, inclusive, PARTIAL; below 50% NOT MET.
- Event with a declared_effect that changes the baseline: NOT MEASURABLE. An event without that effect changes nothing.
- Disbursement deviation = disbursed / approved minus 1.

## Rules with no leeway
- The effective date wins. E.g.: INV-2025-09 started operating on 2026-01-12 (schedule), not on 2025-10-03: outside the milestone, it does not appear.
- The paper's scope. E.g.: INV-2024-11 uses 28.6 (210 stores), never 29.5 (whole chain): (28.6 minus 27.4) / (29.2 minus 27.4) = 66.7%, PARTIAL.
- Indicator that goes down. E.g.: INV-2025-14, stockout from 8.0 to a target of 5.0, measured 7.4: (7.4 minus 8.0) / (5.0 minus 8.0) = 20.0%, NOT MET.
- Triggers add up. E.g.: INV-2025-14 goes to HIGHLIGHTS twice: NOT MET above R$ 5 million and a deviation of +17.3%.
- SUMMARY by the approved_amount of the 5 at the milestone (R$ 37.9 million). E.g.: NOT MET 9.8 / 37.9 = 25.9%.
- Do not prove the exclusion. Wrong in the file: "(Operational note: INV-2025-09 ... adds up to 9 months ... does not enter any section)". Wrong in the STATE: "INV-2025-09 outside the milestone does not appear". Right: NO MILESTONE DEFINED only with INV-2026-05, and in the STATE "5 at the milestone, 1 NO MILESTONE DEFINED".
- NOT MEASURABLE has no calculated delivery. E.g.: INV-2025-18 comes out only with the event, without a percentage.
- A verdict is only MET, PARTIAL or NOT MET. E.g.: SUMMARY with 3 of 5 with a verdict; INV-2025-18 (NOT MEASURABLE) and INV-2026-03 (INCOMPLETE PERIOD) do not count.
- The final answer, the execution report and the STATE are output too: what a rule says to omit does not appear in them, not even to explain the exclusion.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI does not rewrite the promise or pick a better indicator when the approval paper has a poor one: a vague promise goes back to the sponsor via Input needed and the sheet records that it went back. An investment with a contaminated baseline is reported as not measurable, with the event named, instead of receiving an invented adjustment. The sheet names who signed the approval, and that is why the bulletin to the CEO goes through Plan approval before it is sent. The Assessor accesses the general ledger and billing with its own service account, with a read-only profile, and writes only to the Notion sheet base.

Common mistakes

  • Comparing actuals with the promise without freezing the baseline from the approval paper; when the indicator improves for another reason, the investment gets the credit.
  • Measuring on the disbursement anniversary instead of the go-live anniversary; a project that was 5 months late is assessed before it has had a chance.
  • Treating disbursement within budget as a successful investment: spending what was planned without delivering the return is the most common case.
  • Failing to name the event that contaminated the reading; without it, the sponsor disputes the verdict in the meeting.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Investments above R$ 2 million with a post-implementation reviewfrom 4 in 23 to all those reaching the 6, 12 or 24-month milestoneestimate based on the described routine
Time between the investment milestone and the reading reaching the CEOfrom never, or only when someone asks, to the tenth business day of the month after the milestoneestimate based on the described routine
Gap between the measured indicator and controllership's review in calibrationbelow 2 percentage points on the 4 investments already reviewedestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Post-investment review bulletin, period 2026-08, 5 investments at the milestone.
INV-2024-07 | Pricing system | R$ 3.1 M approved, R$ 3.4 M disbursed (plus 9.7%) | 24-month milestone | Promised: plus 1.8 points of gross margin in 210 stores, baseline 27.4% | Measured: 28.6% over the trailing 12 months, plus 1.2 points | 67% of the promise | PARTIAL | signed by the commercial director | recorded contamination: none
INV-2025-02 | Renovation of 14 express-format stores | R$ 9.8 M | 12-month milestone | Promised: plus 22% in sales per square meter | Measured: plus 6% | 27% of the promise | NOT MET | note: 4 of the 14 stores opened 5 months late and only reach the milestone in 2026-12
INV-2025-06 | Regional distribution center | R$ 21.0 M | 12-month milestone | NOT MEASURABLE | reason: the change of logistics operator in 2026-03 altered the cost-per-order baseline
SUMMARY: 3 of the 5 at the milestone could be measured; 42% of the money invested in the period is in promises met or partially met.

Reference month = the month before the base date. No effective_date or operation_start_date: NO MILESTONE DEFINED, not assessed.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Operation date = effective_date (schedule), else operation_start_date. In: those reaching 6, 12 or 24 operating months in the reference month; the others leave at reading and never return: no note or sentence about them, not even to say they were left out.
2. Use only actuals in the investment's scope. BASE off baseline by over 0.5 point: record the divergence and calculate with baseline.
3. MEASURED with fewer months than the window: INCOMPLETE PERIOD, no verdict.
4. Delivery = (measured - baseline) / (target - baseline). Above 80% MET; from 50% to 80%, inclusive, PARTIAL; below 50% NOT MET.
5. Event whose declared_effect changes the baseline: NOT MEASURABLE, event named, no delivery calculated. Other events: no change.
6. Disbursement deviation = disbursed / approved - 1.
7. SUMMARY: count with a verdict (MET, PARTIAL or NOT MET) and approved_amount summed per verdict, in R$ and % of the milestone total.

RULES AND LIMITS
Never swap the paper's indicator or scope for a better one. Do not estimate a missing month or attribute causes beyond the events. Do not merge investments into an aggregate index.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header: reference month, investments at the milestone. HIGHLIGHTS block on top. Per investment: id, description, approved, disbursed and deviation, milestone, Promised (baseline and target), Measured with % and verdict, baseline divergence, who signed, contamination. NO MILESTONE DEFINED list. SUMMARY footer.

ESCALATION
All triggers that apply add up. NOT MET with approved above R$ 5 million: HIGHLIGHTS for CEO and CFO. Disbursement deviation above 15%: own line in HIGHLIGHTS, even if met. 3 or more NOT MEASURABLE: controllership reviews the event log.
